description: Saving, continuing, a best score kept between runs, and translations

examples.intent: Continue from where you left off

input.natural_language: A title screen with New game and Continue (only when there is a save); every room saves on entry, and the best score is kept between runs

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="saves" type="game">
  <q:set name="score" value="0" type="number" />
  <q:set name="best" value="0" type="number" saved="true" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="chars" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />

  <qg:scene name="title" width="270" height="144">
    <qg:menu>
      <qg:button label="New game">
        <q:set name="score" value="0" />
        <qg:goto-scene name="room-1" />
      </qg:button>
      <qg:button label="Continue" if="{has_save()}"><qg:continue /></qg:button>
    </qg:menu>
    <qg:hud position="bottom-center"><qg:counter bind="best" label="BEST " /></qg:hud>
  </qg:scene>

  <qg:scene name="room-1" width="270" height="144" save="true">
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="chars" frame="0" x="40" y="72" hitbox="14x14" />
    <qg:on-input action="jump">
      <q:set name="score" value="{score + 1}" />
      <q:set name="best" value="{max(best, score)}" />
    </qg:on-input>
    <qg:on-input action="select">
      <qg:save scene="room-2" />
      <qg:goto-scene name="room-2" />
    </qg:on-input>
  </qg:scene>

  <qg:scene name="room-2" width="270" height="144" save="true">
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="chars" frame="0" x="40" y="72" hitbox="14x14" />
    <qg:on-input action="cancel"><qg:goto-scene name="title" /></qg:on-input>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>
expected_output.runtime_behavior: Entering a room with save="true" saves the game state and that room. Continue shows only when has_save() is true and brings the game state back and goes to the saved room. best has saved="true": it is kept between runs even without a save.

examples.intent: The game in Portuguese and Spanish

input.natural_language: Translate the game's texts to Portuguese and Spanish, with a menu button that switches the language

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="langs" type="game">
  <q:set name="coins" value="0" type="number" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="chars" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <qg:language lang="pt" name="Português">
    <qg:phrase text="Play" as="Jogar" />
    <qg:phrase text="Language" as="Idioma" />
    <qg:phrase text="COINS" as="MOEDAS" />
    <qg:phrase text="Hello!" as="Olá!" />
  </qg:language>
  <qg:language lang="es" name="Español">
    <qg:phrase text="Play" as="Jugar" />
    <qg:phrase text="Language" as="Idioma" />
    <qg:phrase text="COINS" as="MONEDAS" />
    <qg:phrase text="Hello!" as="¡Hola!" />
  </qg:language>

  <qg:scene name="title" width="270" height="144">
    <qg:menu>
      <qg:button label="Play"><qg:goto-scene name="main" /></qg:button>
      <qg:button label="{tr('Language') + ': ' + language()}"><qg:next-language /></qg:button>
    </qg:menu>
  </qg:scene>

  <qg:scene name="main" width="270" height="144">
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="chars" frame="0" x="40" y="72" hitbox="14x14" />
    <qg:hud>
      <qg:counter bind="coins" label="COINS" />
      <qg:text value="{tr('Hello!')}" />
    </qg:hud>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>
expected_output.runtime_behavior: Texts written in the game (a button's label, a counter's label) are shown in the player's language when a phrase gives them; tr() translates a text an expression puts together. The language button cycles English, Português, Español and the choice is kept for the next run.
